messages.text: Rename this label to "Your first name"

agent.managerSummary:
The first-name label is served from the Wix Forms dashboard, not the jay-html, so renaming it in code would break the binding. Change the "First name" field to "Your first name" in the [Wix dashboard form editor](https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35) and /contact will pick it up automatically.
Dispatched to the /contact lane — the worker will update the first-name label to "Your first name".

lanes.name: /contact
lanes.summary:
Validation passes (warnings are pre-existing and unrelated to the contact form). The page jay-html was intentionally left unchanged.

**What I didn't change (and why):** The "First name" label on `/contact` is `{contact.firstNameD142.label}` — it is served from the Wix form definition for form id `e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35`. The contract's `editingGuide` (and the general source-editing rule in `agent-kit/designer/source-editing.md`) say this is dashboard-managed content and must not be hard-coded in jay-html — doing so would freeze the label and break the binding on every other page that reads it.

**Where to rename the field:** in the Wix dashboard form builder:
https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35

Change the "First name" field's label to **Your first name** there, and `/contact` will pick it up automatically.
